name: Pastor
storyline: You are a young pastor that is closing the church for the night. After your regular duties you get involved in a mysterious polt going on amongst your congregation.
summary:
Pastor is a short atmospheric horror experience combining elements of a walking simulator, psychological thriller, and visual demo.

Originally created for a game jam that never took place, the project was later completed and released as an ultra-indie title. It was developed almost entirely by one person, with additional voice acting and several 3D models contributed by members of the developer’s community, all credited in the game.

Expect a small, experimental experience focused on atmosphere, exploration, and unsettling events rather than complex gameplay.
